credits.title: Upiro
credits.overview: Spain, 1755. Ana is sent to a cloistered monastery where several nuns are afflicted by a mysterious  disease. With the help of an unorthodox priest, the young novice uncovers an ancient legend and  malevolent force: a bloodthirsty upiro.

credits.title: Calcetines
credits.overview: In the 1990s, Rafa and Álvaro are quietly in love, forced to keep their relationship hidden from those around them. credits.title: Frío en las manos
credits.overview: A psychologist helps an elderly woman in her final years while investigating the death of her partner.

credits.title: Trato Humano
credits.overview: An elderly woman accustomed to human interaction verbalizes what she needs to be heard.

credits.title: Café Monumental
credits.overview: An elderly woman who owns a tavern receives a visit from a suspicious stranger with an offer to buy her establishment, something that, apparently, the owner will not be able to refuse. But first, she has to invite him to try her famous coffee.

credits.title: Mamie
credits.overview: Carla receives a disturbing call from her mother, Anne. Her grandmother, Mamie, wants to die. With this news, they decide to travel to be together one last time and say goodbye to Mamie. The reunion, initially affectionate, becomes muddied as old grudges buried under a history of family abandonment come to light.

credits.title: La fuga
credits.overview: In a retirement home for former professional musicians, a newcomer convinces some of his mates to embark on an exciting adventure that will change their lives.

credits.title: Sestil
credits.overview: Lola, submerged in the transition from child to adult, within her silence has to assume the sale of the house in the family town that implies the acceptance of the death of her grandfather together with the oblivion of the past.

credits.title: All in Favor
credits.overview: What begins as an ordinary board in a traditional apartment building to vote the renewal of the elevator, turns into an unexpected debate about the limits of pacific coexistence.

credits.title: The Hunt
credits.overview: Alba, an elderly woman living with her daughter, is unhappy with the way her daughter’s partner treats her. When she finds herself alone with him, she will have to decide how far she is willing to go in order to save her most loved one from a life of suffering.

credits.title: Dama de Porto Pim
credits.overview: "Dama de Porto Pim" tells the story of a rich woman who arrives at a little Portuguese island while her husband is in the II World War; there, a humble fisherman, promised to marry a girl of the town, falls in love with her, and she will also fall in love with him, but his husband could come back.

credits.title: No Pain, No Gain
credits.overview: David is a teenager who feels he doesn't belong to a life where his family, friends and the girl he loves seem not to understand him.

credits.title: La Regenta
credits.overview: The imaginary city of Vetusta, a symbol of anachronistic and oppressive traditions, is the realm of hypocrisy and intolerance that makes Ana Ozores's life unbearable and inevitably tragic.

credits.title: Réquiem por un campesino español
credits.overview: Hypocrisy and betrayal are the two dramatic pivots in this effective, emotionally gripping tragedy about the life and death of Paco (Antonio Banderas), a Spanish peasant who had been fighting against the feudal landowning system that kept farmers impoverished.
